From 96d88f65adfbcaca153afd7d3e20d74ba379c599 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Brian Foster <bfoster@redhat.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 06:44:00 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] virtiofs: include a newline in sysfs tag

The internal tag string doesn't contain a newline. Append one when
emitting the tag via sysfs.

[Stefan] Orthogonal to the newline issue, sysfs_emit(buf, "%s", fs->tag) is
needed to prevent format string injection.

Signed-off-by: Brian Foster <bfoster@redhat.com>
Fixes: a8f62f50b4e4 ("virtiofs: export filesystem tags through sysfs")
Signed-off-by: Miklos Szeredi <mszeredi@redhat.com>

diff --git a/fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c b/fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c
index 322af827a232..bb3e941b9503 100644
--- a/fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c
+++ b/fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c
@@ -170,7 +170,7 @@ static ssize_t tag_show(struct kobject *kobj,
 {
 	struct virtio_fs *fs = container_of(kobj, struct virtio_fs, kobj);
 
-	return sysfs_emit(buf, fs->tag);
+	return sysfs_emit(buf, "%s\n", fs->tag);
 }
 
 static struct kobj_attribute virtio_fs_tag_attr = __ATTR_RO(tag);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c`**
   - The function `tag_show` was modified to append a newline character to the output when emitting the filesystem tag via sysfs. The line:
     ```c
     return sysfs_emit(buf, fs->tag);
     ```
     was changed to:
     ```c
     return sysfs_emit(buf, "%s\n", fs->tag);
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `virtio_fs.c` addresses two issues: it adds a newline to the sysfs output for better formatting and prevents potential format string injection vulnerabilities by using the `sysfs_emit` function with a format specifier. This change is directly related to the previous implementation that exported filesystem tags through sysfs, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `a8f62f50b4e4`. The addition of the newline enhances the usability of the sysfs interface, while the format specifier improves security.

virtiofs: include a newline in sysfs tag

The internal tag string doesn't contain a newline. Append one when
emitting the tag via sysfs.

[Stefan] Orthogonal to the newline issue, sysfs_emit(buf, "%s", fs->tag) is
needed to prevent format string injection.

Signed-off-by: Brian Foster <bfoster@redhat.com>
Fixes: a8f62f50b4e4 ("virtiofs: export filesystem tags through sysfs")
Signed-off-by: Miklos Szeredi <mszeredi@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of a newline character in the output of the filesystem tag when emitted via sysfs, which could lead to formatting issues in the sysfs interface. Additionally, the lack of a format specifier in the `sysfs_emit` function call posed a risk of format string injection vulnerabilities.

 	struct virtio_fs *fs = container_of(kobj, struct virtio_fs, kobj);
 
-	return sysfs_emit(buf, fs->tag);
+	return sysfs_emit(buf, "%s\n", fs->tag);
 }
